description: Free, open-source MCP server that gives AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, ZCode…) design inspiration from award-winning websites — search with real screenshots, pull design DNA, capture and record live sites. A Mobbin alternative. No API key.
